skills.description: Build new or review existing native iOS UIKit screens from Figma, using SnapKit or Auto Layout, then iterate until the live UI matches the design. Use for from-zero Figma-to-code implementation, visual review, UI polish, Figma node/screenshot comparison, Maestro navigation flows, Lookin MCP hierarchy/screenshot inspection, simulator screenshots, accessibility identifiers, or repository harness commands.
skills.description_zh:
figma-ios-build-review 是一个面向 iOS 原生界面的 Figma 还原与视觉审查 skill。

它用于从 Figma 设计稿构建新的 UIKit 页面，或审查已有 UIKit 页面与设计稿的视觉一致性。流程会先读取 Figma 节点和项目规则，再按现有 UIKit、SnapKit 或 Auto Layout 写法实现界面，并通过真实运行状态、模拟器截图、Maestro 流程和 Lookin 层级检查不断迭代，直到 live app 尽量贴近设计稿。

适合用在这些场景：

从 Figma 新建 iOS 原生页面、组件、cell
对已有 UIKit 页面做视觉还原检查和 UI polish
比较 Figma 设计稿与模拟器截图
通过 Maestro 导航到目标页面并做验证
使用 Lookin 检查 UIKit 层级、尺寸、颜色、间距和截图
记录无法完全匹配设计稿的真实运行数据差异
它的重点不是“硬凑设计稿”，而是在保持真实 app 状态和项目工程规范的前提下，系统地完成 Figma 到 iOS UI 的实现、对比、修正和验证。
skills.name: figma-ios-build-review

Trigger whenever the user mentions \"deck,\" \"slides,\" \"presentation,\" or references a .pptx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

skills.description:
This skill should be used when the user needs to parse channel Wish List data and automatically classify offers by geographic region into company-standard Excel templates (e.g., MENA/US, LATAM, APAC, Betting, ForexCrypto).

It reads parsed Wish List CSV data, applies multi-rule geo classification logic, fills in company template Excel files, and syncs results to Tencent Docs.

Applicable for affiliate BD teams managing offers across multiple verticals and regions, requiring standardized regional reporting.
